title: Open-ended WR-90 radiating at 10 GHz from a metal block in a box lined with a perfectly matched layer: power balance
source: Energy conservation: in a lossless structure the power the waveguide port's TE10 delivers, P_inc (1 − |S11|²), leaves through any closed surface round the antenna (Poynting's theorem; D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., §1.6)

quantities.quantity: radiated power over the power the port delivers
quantities.reason: the port's modal projection and the Huygens box's Poynting integral, two independent measures of one solution: 0.990 to 0.997 at four and five elements per wavelength, as the mesh round the aperture changes (the layer's residual reflection and the box's quadrature)
